reports.t: "التلفزيون السوري": مقتل عنصرين من قوى الأمن الداخلي وإصابة آخرين جراء اعتداء مسلح استهدف دورية في دير الزور
reports.en: Syrian Television: two elements of the internal security forces were killed and others injured by an armed attack targeting a patrol in Deir al-Zawr.

reports.t: "الحدث": أنباء عن قتلى في هجوم شنه مسلحون على دورية لقوى الأمن الداخلي السوري بدير الزور
reports.en: "The incident: reports of murder in an armed attack on a patrol of Syrian internal security forces in Deir-Zor."

reports.t: "العربية": مسلحون يستهدفون بالرصاص دورية لقوى الأمن الداخلي السوري بدير الزور
reports.en: Arab: gunmen targeted by a patrol of Syrian internal security forces at Deir-Zor

rising.en: Yemeni government forces: We are facing harmful confrontations with the Al-Houthi group in the LTTE south of Ta`izz governorate

rating: Stars combine the kind of newsroom (public broadcaster or news agency 5, newspaper or business daily 4, broadcaster or digital site 3.5, tabloid or state-controlled 2.5) with its reach in the country (top 3 +0.5, ranks 8-10 -0.25). State-controlled outlets are labelled as such.
